notes: Writing CFG_SELECT loads the selected field into CFG_PORT; reading or writing CFG_PORT accesses it.
Ids $00-$0F act on the index selected in window A (IDXA_SELECT) and $10-$1F on the one in window B (IDXB_SELECT); the low nibble picks the field.
Writing a current-address byte refreshes that window's data port. Writing SPEED_H commits the staged PHI2 speed.
